reason: I already make my flyers in Canva and they do the job. I can't tell from four slides whether a studio across the world would understand my shop or my customers, and I'd rather pay someone I can call in person.
objection: Is a remote studio worth it compared to someone local? I can't meet them, and I don't know if they'd get my market right.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a finished brand from a business like mine, my town or my kind of trade, with the price stated up front.
